Sound picker, round 3

New sounds for actions that were silent: steps on every ground, wading, swimming, and more. Each sound has a few options. Play the single takes, and for steps press Walk to hear the option in the slime's own walking rhythm, the way the game repeats it.

Pick one option per sound. Drop single takes you don't like with ✕, or choose Neither and say how it should sound. The game already plays the option marked in game; you can also try options in the playground (see the note at the bottom). Press My picks are final when you are done and Claude applies them.
